bull.b: The sharp shift to positive earnings and strong operating margins indicates that Protalix can convert commercial activity into meaningful profit. If product sales remain durable, this improved earnings base can support internal funding, pipeline investment, and greater resilience over the next several quarters.

A debt-free structure and substantial liquid resources give Protalix flexibility to fund operations and advance clinical programs without near-term financing pressure. This strengthens resilience during revenue variability and preserves management’s ability to allocate capital toward commercial and pipeline opportunities.

Growing Elfabrio sales, broader geographic access, and approval of a more convenient dosing schedule can expand patient reach and improve the product’s competitive position. These structural commercial and regulatory developments provide a foundation for recurring growth beyond a single reporting period.

bear.t: Partner Concentration And Uneven Revenue Timing
bear.b: Dependence on Chiesi and uneven shipment or inventory decisions make reported revenue less predictable than underlying product demand. This volatility can complicate forecasting, create uneven cash conversion, and make it harder for Protalix to sustain consistent earnings across the next several quarters.

The large milestone materially boosted first-half revenue but is not expected to recur on the same basis. Comparisons may therefore weaken when attention shifts to recurring product sales, making current growth and profitability less representative of Protalix’s ongoing operating performance.

The observed anti-drug antibody rate and unresolved dosing strategy create meaningful uncertainty around PRX-115’s development path. Immunogenicity and infusion-related reactions could affect regimen selection, timelines, and eventual market positioning, limiting the pipeline’s near-term ability to add durable value.
